title: Relay-backed web documentation loading
observed_behavior: The documentation client could persist an empty docs event array in localStorage and later treat that empty cache as valid documentation data, preventing a fresh relay query and making docs appear unavailable even when NIP-23 documentation events exist on the relay.
intended_behavior: The web documentation pages load user guide content from scoped Nostr subscriptions to NIP-23 kind 30023 events tagged bahia-docs. Empty event snapshots are not documentation truth and must not be cached as a substitute for relay data.
architecture_constraints: No bundled/local documentation fallback in production web loading.
No fake Nostr events generated from local markdown.
Use scoped relay query filters for kind 30023 and #t=bahia-docs.
